security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Memory scanner and debugger for Linux and Windows
bundle.longDescription: HeapHook is an open-source memory scanner, editor and debugger for Linux and Windows. It scans a running process for values, edits and freezes them, disassembles code, sets breakpoints, scans for pointers and loads Cheat Engine tables.
